messages:
Maya (Docs): Heads up — I'm updating the Dedicated handbook to add a small scale-policy YAML example and a suggested eval prompt for tenant isolation checks. Need a quick pair on wording + a link fix. PR incoming.
Omar (Eng-Runtime): on it. can you paste the YAML draft so I can sanity-check labels and preemption wording?
Maya (Docs): sure, draft below:
Maya (Docs): ```yaml
scalePolicy:
  minReplicas: 1
  maxReplicas: 10
  cooldownSeconds: 300
  tenantLabel: "team"
  preemption: "best-effort"
```
Linh (Docs): I’d avoid using `preemption` alone — we usually call it `preemptionPolicy` and document reserved vs shared behavior. also add a one-line note about reserved pools getting stronger isolation and SLA differences.
Maya (Docs): good call — will change to `preemptionPolicy: "best-effort"` and add a sentence about Reserved pools (SLA: 99.95) vs Shared (best-effort).
Raj (Eng-Platform): @Maya can you also include a tiny eval prompt under 'quality monitoring' so we can run a quick regression test after model swaps? something like: "Given the model output and the original user query, answer yes/no if the response actually answers the query, and add a one-line reason." keep super short.
Maya (Docs): draft eval prompt: 
Maya (Docs): ```text
Evaluate: Does the response answer the user's question?
- input: <user query>
- output: <model response>
- expected: yes/no + 1-sentence reason
```
Maya (Docs): PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 — title: "Dedicated: small scalePolicy YAML + eval prompt for isolation checks" :docs-bot:
deploy-bot: PR opened by maya — link-checker: build passed but 1 broken anchor found in /handbook/dedicated/ -> https://go.redwood/handbook/dedicated#scalepolicies
Omar (Eng-Runtime): i'll take the anchor fix. also can we add an SDK example (python) showing how to set tenant labels during dedicated pool creation? one-liner is enough.
Maya (Docs): draft python snippet:
Maya (Docs): ```python
# create a dedicated pool with tenant label
client.create_dedicated_pool(name="team-a", scale_policy={"min":1, "max":10, "cooldown":300}, labels={"tenant":"team-a"})
```
Linh (Docs): move that to docs/examples/dedicated_provisioning.py and reference it from the handbook section. add a short note about the IAM role required to create pools.
Raj (Eng-Platform): for QA add a tiny eval case to catch misrouting or model-variant regressions e.g. prompt: "Which deployment served this response?" expected token: `redwood-dedicated-v1`. Add to PR as evals/tests.
Maya (Docs): thanks — i'll update the PR: swap `preemption` -> `preemptionPolicy`, add reserved/shared SLA note, move python snippet to examples/, add the short eval prompt, and fix the anchor. ping me for a final review after i push.
Omar (Eng-Runtime): lgtm, will review after the anchor fix.
Maya (Docs): updated and pushed the branch — changes pushed at 1718507380
Linh (Docs): :thumbsup:
Raj (Eng-Platform): quick nit: can we also add a one-line cross-ref to the Optimize guide about batching implications for tiny minReplicas? helps readers understand latency vs cost tradeoffs.
Maya (Docs): noted, will add one sentence in the 'scalePolicy' section. thanks all.
